summary_md:
**Sumit Agrawal ([@attnsumit](https://x.com/attnsumit/status/2115289582606692522))** flags two DGX Spark speed-ups that landed the same week and recommends Spark owners try both:

1. **Mia's AI Lab** — a TensorFold build for running **Qwen3.8 Flash Next on a single DGX Spark**.
2. **NVIDIA's technical blog** — *3 Ways to Boost MoE Inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark*.

The post itself is a pointer; the substance lives in the two linked pages.

referenced_urls.title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next on one DGX Spark with TensorFold · Mia's AI Lab
3 Ways to Boost MoE Inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark | NVIDIA Technical Blog

relevance: Two concrete, Spark-specific optimization sources for MoE reasoning models in exactly the hardware class Richard runs.
